verdict.rationale: Omnara ships a first-party Slack connector for interacting with agents, and agents can be sent corrections, given queued tasks, and pause to ask questions, so delegating and discussing work from a chat surface is plausible. However, no evidence shows @-mentioning or tagging an agent inside a chat thread, or thread-based discussion of a bug. Missing for 10: documented tag/mention-in-thread invocation, thread-scoped conversation and delegation flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Slack workflow.
